risks.risk: Wrong venue or historical schedule could misdirect visitors.
risks.mitigation: Omit conflicting address and unverified schedule; ask visitors to confirm directly.

risks.risk: Sensitive personal/health information could be collected unnecessarily.
risks.mitigation: No form; no diagnostic eligibility; no request for health details.

risks.risk: Public contact email may no longer be monitored.
risks.mitigation: Clearly mark as published contact; mailbox deliverability remains to be confirmed.

risks.risk: Provisional design could conflict with official brand identity.
risks.mitigation: Use neutral warm design; mark assets as provisional; replace once verified.

risks.risk: Production readiness cannot be established without a host/domain.
risks.mitigation: No deployment claim; production SEO, headers, runtime, monitoring and rollback remain blocked.

risks.risk: Global Escape handler could unexpectedly focus a hidden or irrelevant menu trigger while the menu is closed.
risks.mitigation: Only close and restore focus when aria-expanded is true; add deterministic interaction regression test.
risks.residual: Firefox/WebKit and manual screen-reader behavior remain unobserved.

risks.risk: Dated 2026 activity details are based on a third-party mirror rather than direct Facebook retrieval.
risks.mitigation: Label as public-post examples and non-recurring; retain source confidence; confirm before future news updates.

risks.risk: Illustrations could be mistaken for documentary photos of real members/events.
risks.mitigation: Alt text and visible captions explicitly state original illustrations, not event photographs.

risks.risk: Scroll reveals could hide content if script/observer fails.
risks.mitigation: Apply has-reveal only when IntersectionObserver exists and reduced motion is off; visible default otherwise.

loop_002_change_risk: R1 — local navigation keyboard interaction behavior
loop_003_change_risk: R2 — public content and page composition changed; imagery remains local and no personal data or transactional workflows added.
